title: SSL/TLS Connection Encryption
description: Secure data in transit with TLS certificates, configure sslmode (verify-full), and mandate encrypted connections.

data.text: Unencrypted database traffic exposes plain-text SQL statements, query results, and passwords to network eavesdroppers. PostgreSQL supports native SSL/TLS encryption for all client-server communication.

rows: Encrypts traffic, but does not verify server identity against CA certificate.
Verifies server certificate against trusted Root CA.
Verifies certificate and matches host name against certificate CN/SAN. Industry standard!

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Always use `sslmode=verify-full` in production connection strings to prevent MITM attacks.
Reject unencrypted connections in `pg_hba.conf` using `hostssl` instead of `host`.
